meta.homeDescription: ZondaSat builds a 3-year crop rotation plan for your parcel in San Juan using NASA climate data.
meta.resultsDescription: Your three-year crop rotation plan, season by season.

welcome.title: Plan what to plant in your field over the next three years
welcome.subtitle: Mark your parcel on the map and we will build a crop rotation plan using NASA climate data for your area in San Juan.
welcome.step1: Mark the corners of your parcel
welcome.step2: We analyze the climate of your area
welcome.step3: Get your plan, season by season
welcome.note: Takes less than a minute. No account required.
welcome.footer: Prototype created for NASA Space Apps 2026 using NASA POWER data.

economico.objetivo: Obtain the highest profit per hectare
economico.convieneSi: Best suited if your water supply is secure and you want the highest financial return.

hidrico.objetivo: Use the least amount of irrigation water
hidrico.convieneSi: Best suited if your irrigation turn is short or water is scarce.

suelo.objetivo: Leave the soil in the best long-term condition
suelo.convieneSi: Best suited if your plot is depleted or you plan to farm it for many years to come.

personalizado.convieneSi: Reflects the balance between profit, water, and soil that you selected.
